text: $agent-seat hey figure out why it wont let me loop cut at the current state of the model loaded right now
resolution: Diagnosed the live editor without mutating topology. The hotkey routes (shell status is 'Loop Cut - hotkey'), but no loop-cut session opens (blocking null, native pending 0). Face mode and one authored face are selected, while the active native part scope is only Cube 1. The failure is therefore in meshLoopCutFaceBegin before preview/UI creation; the strongest current-state cause is a stale face selection outside the active Cube 1 scope. The current mesh also has open/non-manifold edges, but preview failures would still open the popup and show a fallback, so those do not explain the missing UI.
